result.reason: The operative language includes all preferred coverages and limits, including conditional USD 5 million cyber coverage, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. However, it unnecessarily requires all coverage to continue for one year after the Term, which is not in the playbook and is awkward for occurrence-based CGL and workers’ compensation. It also improperly relocates subsection (iii) ahead of the Section 14 heading, disrupting the clause structure. The existing substantive language is otherwise preserved.
